headline: Emergency Leak Repair: What to Ask Your Plumber
articleBody:
When you're facing an emergency water leak in your Las Vegas home or business, it's a stressful time. You need fast, effective help, but it's also smart to ask the right questions to ensure you're getting quality service. Our goal at CG Plumbing Solutions is to provide clear communication every step of the way.

First, always confirm they are licensed and insured in Nevada. This protects you in case of any issues during the repair. Our Nevada plumbing license is C-1D/0093216, and we're fully insured. Next, ask about their arrival window for emergency calls. You want to know when to expect help, especially when water is actively leaking. We offer 24/7 emergency dispatch to respond quickly to urgent problems.

It’s also crucial to understand the diagnostic and minimum charges, as well as the overall repair pricing. A reputable plumber, like our team, will provide written options and estimates before any work begins, so you know exactly what to expect. Don't be shy about asking if the repair is temporary or permanent, and what their warranty covers for both parts and labor. You want a lasting solution, not a quick patch.

Finally, inquire about their experience with your specific type of leak, whether it's a burst pipe, a concealed leak, or an issue with a particular fixture. Knowing they have the expertise and equipment, like for leak detection and pressure testing, gives you confidence. If the leak has caused significant damage, ask if they can coordinate with water damage restoration if needed. Getting these questions answered upfront helps you make an informed decision and ensures a smooth repair process.
